name: Autonomous SDLC Workflow Integrity
description: Evaluates 4 standardized execution modes, 10-stage autonomous SDLC, circuit breaker, and rollback protocol

cases.name: Standard Feature Delivery follows the 8-step pipeline through staged review and commit gate

Solo Session Protocol enforces 7-step minimum viable gate
Rollback protocol enforces incident logging in docs/LESSONS.md
Universal test password devos123 is codified in testing guide standards
SDLC pipeline runner writes and reads sdlc-state.json with correct schema
SDLC runner enforces Mandatory Design Gate before implementation stage
SDLC runner produces valid agent delegation prompts for all 10 stages
